TEST 2.0 17:21 1.2 Career Aspirations and Professional Development 1.2.1 My Career Aspirations I am currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, specializing in Data Science for Biology. My interest in biology and medical developments, combined with my scientific background, has motivated me to explore career opportunities that extend beyond traditional laboratory research. While I value my practical laboratory experience, I envision a career in which I can combine my scientific knowledge with communication, business, and advisory responsibilities. I am particularly interested in positions such as Solutions Consultant, Technical Sales Specialist, or Business Development Specialist within the Life Sciences industry. My ideal job would involve interacting with clients, understanding their challenges, presenting technical or scientific solutions, and building professional relationships. I would also enjoy attending conferences, visiting companies, and travelling internationally for business purposes. Ideally, I would like to work in a hybrid environment that offers flexibility, opportunities for professional growth, and attractive salary prospects. Over the next one to two years, I hope to gain further experience and explore opportunities that will help me transition towards this type of career. 1.2.2 My Current Skills and Experience Throughout my studies and professional experience, I have developed a foundation in laboratory techniques, biological sciences, and data analysis. Having worked in three different laboratories, I have gained practical experience in scientific environments and an understanding of laboratory workflows, experimental procedures, and the importance of reliable data. Through my Data Science specialization, I have developed skills in R and RStudio, biological data analysis, and bioinformatics. I have also gained experience with Git, GitHub, and basic Linux and Bash commands. In addition to my technical background, I consider communication, adaptability, and interpersonal skills to be personal strengths. I enjoy interacting with people and working in environments where I can exchange ideas and collaborate with others. 1.2.3 Skills I Want to Develop To move towards my career goals, I would like to further develop both my technical and professional skills. One area I want to improve is the ability to communicate complex scientific information in a clear, accessible, and visually engaging way. This is particularly relevant for advisory and client-facing positions, where technical information often needs to be explained to people with different levels of scientific knowledge. For this reason, I have chosen to focus on interactive dashboard development using R Shiny during the independent learning component of the Workflows course. My goal is to learn how to transform biological datasets into interactive visualizations that allow users to explore and interpret scientific information. Additionally, I would like to improve my presentation, negotiation, and business communication skills. I believe that combining scientific expertise, data literacy, and strong interpersonal skills will help me prepare for a career that connects science, technology, and business.

2 Interactive Data Visualization with R Shiny 2.1 Project Overview For the independent learning component of the Workflows course, I have chosen to develop my skills in interactive dashboard development using R Shiny. My goal is to learn how to build an interactive application that allows users to explore and visualize biological data without needing programming knowledge. This project will involve learning the fundamentals of R Shiny and independently applying them to a biological dataset. 2.2 Why I Chose This Skill As a Life Sciences student specializing in Data Science for Biology, I am interested in combining scientific knowledge with communication and business-oriented responsibilities. My career interests include advisory and client-facing positions within the Life Sciences industry, such as Solutions Consulting, Technical Sales, and Business Development. In these roles, communicating complex scientific information to different audiences is an important skill. I chose R Shiny because it allows me to transform data analyses into interactive applications that can be used by people without programming experience. Since I already have experience with R and RStudio, I can focus on learning dashboard development rather than starting with an entirely new programming language. 2.3 Learning Objectives During this project, I aim to: Understand the basic structure of an R Shiny application. Learn how to create a user interface using Shiny. Understand the principles of reactive programming. Create interactive visualizations with user-controlled filters. Independently develop a functional dashboard using biological data. Document and demonstrate the functionality of my application. 2.4 Learning Plan I have allocated 32 hours to complete this project, including learning, development, testing, and documentation. Activity Hours Planned period Learn the fundamentals of R Shiny 5 18–22 November Learn UI components and reactivity 7 23–29 November Develop an independent dashboard 12 30 November – 6 December Test and improve the application 4 7–13 December Documentation and reflection 4 14–20 December Total 32 2.4.1 Learning Resources I plan to use the official R Shiny documentation, tutorials provided by Posit, and practical examples to learn the fundamentals of dashboard development. I will first follow introductory tutorials to understand the structure of Shiny applications and then apply this knowledge independently to a different biological dataset. The dataset and specific biological application will be selected before development begins, ensuring that the project does not overlap with my Projecticum. 2.5 Demonstrating My Learning To demonstrate the skills I have developed, I intend to create a functional interactive dashboard using a publicly available biological dataset. The dashboard should allow users to explore the data through interactive filters and visualizations. I will document the development process, explain the functionality of the application, and make the source code available through GitHub. If possible, I will also publish the dashboard online so that visitors to my portfolio can interact with it. 2.6 Dashboard Development In development. This section will document the dataset, implementation process, and technical functionality of the dashboard. 2.7 Results and Reflection To be completed after the development of the dashboard. This section will present the final application, demonstrate its functionality, and reflect on the skills acquired during the project.
